svg.title: Who holds each authority on the tutorial mint
svg.desc: The fee payer holds the mint, Confidential Balances, and Scaled UI Amount authorities and the Token ACL config and allowlist. The freeze authority belongs to the Token ACL mint config, and it also governs the default account state. Pause, permanent delegate, permissioned burn, and metadata each have their own key. Two settings are not used on this mint: an optional auditor key, which the Confidential Balances authority can set and which decrypts transfer amounts without signing anything, and a transfer hook, which the tokenized-security template does not include.
